articles.title: OpenClaw Releases 2026.9.5 With Atomic Updates, Plugin Hot Reload, Conversation Sharing, and Expanded GPT Live
articles.summary: OpenClaw 2026.9.5 ships 4,179 pull requests from 502 contributing accounts. The headline change is Atomic Updates, which check the next version against a private copy of your setup while the current Gateway keeps running. The release also adds plugin hot reload, read-only conversation sharing, GPT Live in meetings and calls, shared browser pages, archiving, and guided specialist-agent setup. The post OpenClaw Releases 2026.9.5 With Atomic Updates, Plugin Hot Reload, Conversation Sharing, and Expanded GPT Live appeared first on MarkTechPost .

articles.title: datasette-auth-github 1.0
articles.summary: Release: datasette-auth-github 1.0 I run this GitHub login plugin on the agent.datasette.io demo site and I noticed that my authenticated sessions weren't lasting very long. It turned out that the plugin was setting cookies without a Max-Age parameter, so they were expiring at the end of a browser session (which in Mobile Safari seems to happen pretty often, independently of how you are using the app.) I fixed that in #80 and, since this plugin has been around for quite a while and is tested against both Datasette 0.65.x and Datasette 1.0ax, I decided to bump it up to a 1.0 release. articles.title: AI actress suffers glitch during bizarre Piers Morgan TV interview
articles.summary: A Piers Morgan interview with a popular AI actress took an odd turn after the computer-generated avatar began speaking Chinese. Tilly Norwood, a character created by production company Particle6 who describes herself as the world’s first AI actress, was in conversation with Morgan and actor Tom Conti on Piers Morgan Uncensored when talk turned to her new feature film Misaligned. When asked by Conti whether her co-stars on the project were human or AI, Norwood began a reply before pausing and unexpectedly switching to Cantonese, leaving Conti dumbfounded.
